title: Release engineering meeting notes - 2026-09-15
content:
Release Engineering meeting notes
Date: 2026-09-15
Facilitator: Evan Thompson
Attendees: Evan Thompson, Priya Nair, Samir Patel, Jules Carter, Aisha Raman, Ben Hsu (SRE - joined for rollout window)
Absentees: N/A

Agenda:
1) Status of current release train (v1.14 RC)
2) Hotfix rollout for v1.13.2
3) Changelog review and release notes prep
4) Canary telemetry & rollback thresholds
5) CI/CD flakiness updates and release blockers
6) Action items and schedule for next week

Notes by topic:
1) v1.14 release train (RC)
- Current state: RC deployed to staged canary group (10% traffic) on 2026-09-14 21:10 UTC. No critical errors so far.
- Key features in v1.14: improved KV cache eviction heuristic (INF-2345), batching latency improvements for short sequences, and new quantized ops landing from runtime team (PR #782).
- Metrics observed (24h): p50 latency down ~6% on API test harness; error rate stable at baseline. Memory usage +3% for a subset of models using extended KV window.
- Outstanding items before GA: docs update for model pinning behavior, finalize upgrade playbook, update rollout config in console.fleet yaml.
- Decision: Proceed to broad canary (50% traffic) tomorrow 2026-09-16 02:00 UTC if no new errors surface. Priya to validate A/B traffic split config and run smoke tests.

2) Hotfix for v1.13.2
- Background: v1.13.2 contains a regression in streamed response chunking for clients with early connection close (reported INF-2399).
- Hotfix PR created: platform/pull/456. Patch includes safety check and a defensive timeout.
- Canaries: hotfix deployed to dedicated customers group and internal testbeds. Initial results show successful mitigation but one flaky test (stream-reconnect) failing intermittently in CI.
- Action: Samir to push an additional test harness change and re-run full streaming test suite by EOD 2026-09-15. Target hotfix-wide rollout 2026-09-16 06:00 UTC pending green tests and SRE signoff.

3) Changelog & release notes
- Draft release notes located on Confluence (link in linked_artifacts). Need concise bullet list of breaking changes and upgrade notes for dedicated/private customers.
- Required write-ups: runtime quant ops (Jules), KV eviction behavior (Priya), API contract clarifications for streaming (Samir).
- Deadline: final release notes by 2026-09-16 10:00 UTC so marketing can prep announcement.

4) Canary telemetry and rollback thresholds
- Current rollback triggers: error rate > 2x baseline for 5m OR latency p95 increase > 30% sustained for 10m. Review suggested lowering error threshold to 1.5x for critical endpoints.
- Decision: keep current thresholds for this train but enable stricter monitoring on model-serving endpoints (authz, billing) with alerts to on-call SRE.
- Telemetry gaps: lack of token-level cost delta in canary dashboards. Action: Aisha to add token-cost delta tiles to canary dashboard before broad canary.

5) CI/CD flakiness and blockers
- Observed: two flaky tests in the build pipeline affecting release window:
  - stream-reconnect (intermittent timeout) - failing ~8% of runs
  - model-quant-compat (occasionally fails on older GPUs) - failing ~3%
- Mitigations: create quarantined test stage to avoid blocking canary promotion; longer term: invest in lab repro for stream-reconnect.
- Blocker: dedicated customer smoke test for network egress policy failing in staging due to a config drift (network policy rule missing). Ben (SRE) to remediate and validate by 2026-09-15 23:00 UTC.

6) Rollout windows and coordination
- Broad canary (50%) planned 2026-09-16 02:00 UTC (see above).
- GA/Full rollout tentative 2026-09-17 04:00 UTC pending stability and documentation signoff.
- Communication: notify Dedicated customers via private slack channel 24h before GA; update status.redwood.ai during broad canary.

Action Items (owners + due dates):
- Priya Nair: Validate A/B traffic split config & run smoke tests for v1.14 (due 2026-09-16 01:30 UTC)
- Samir Patel: Fix stream-reconnect test harness and re-run streaming test suite (due 2026-09-15 EOD)
- Jules Carter: Draft runtime quantization section for release notes (due 2026-09-16 09:00 UTC)
- Aisha Raman: Add token-cost delta to canary dashboard (due 2026-09-16 00:30 UTC)
- Ben Hsu (SRE): Remediate staging network policy drift and validate dedicated smoke test (due 2026-09-15 23:00 UTC)
- Evan Thompson: Coordinate customer notification message and GA checklist (due 2026-09-16 12:00 UTC)

Decisions made:
- Proceed to broad canary for v1.14 on 2026-09-16 02:00 UTC if no regressions; thresholds remain unchanged for this train.
- Hotfix v1.13.2 rollout scheduled for 2026-09-16 06:00 UTC pending CI and SRE signoff.

Risks / Open questions / Parking lot:
- Risk: quant ops may increase memory usage on older GPU types; need compatibility notes for Dedicated customers (Jules to include).
- Open question: should we shorten rollback error threshold permanently? Parking for product/ops discussion next week.
- Parking lot: postmortem template for any GA rollback (Evan to draft).

Quick notes to self / TODOs:
- Double-check release tags and docker image tagging convention for v1.14 (ensure backward-compatible tag names).
- Confirm upgrade playbook includes explicit step to clear old KV caches when toggling eviction policy.
- Keep an eye on token-cost delta — throttles could materially impact customer unit economics.

Next meeting: 2026-09-22 09:00 UTC (weekly cadence)

Attachments / links referenced:
- Confluence: Release Trains Q3 2026 (see linked_artifacts)
- PRs: platform/pull/456 (hotfix), runtime/pull/782 (quant ops)
- JIRA: INF-2345 (KV eviction), INF-2399 (streaming regression)

End of notes.
